query:
SELECT s.id as saleId, s.saleDate, s.status, js.journalId, j.status as journalStatus, j.date as journalDate, j.description 
FROM sales s 
LEFT JOIN journalSources js ON js.sourceType = 'sale' AND js.sourceId = s.id 
LEFT JOIN journals j ON j.id = js.journalId 
WHERE s.id = 48510001;
